question: Manju Barggavee was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2019 for her contribution to which Indian classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manju Barggavee** was awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2019** for her contribution to** Kuchipudi**, an Indian classical dance form that originated in the state of **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• **Kuchipudi **is characterized by fast footwork, graceful body movements, and expressive facial expressions.
 
• It is traditionally performed by both male and female dancers, and often tells **mythological stories** through dance dramas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam,** another popular Indian classical dance form, originated in the state of **Tamil Nadu.**
 
• It is known for its **intricate hand gestures, precise footwork,** and elaborate **facial expressions.**
 
• **Kathak**, yet another classical dance form, originated in **North India.**
 
• It is characterized by **fast spins, rhythmic footwork, and storytelling **through dance.
 
• **Mohiniyattam**, a classical dance form from the state of Kerala, is known for its **graceful movements and subtle expressions.**
 
• It is performed mainly by **female dancers** and often tells stories of love and devotion through dance.
